offenses.message: Assignment Branch Condition size for persist_configuration! is too high. [<2, 26, 1> 26.1/26]

Use a guard clause (`return if options.is_a?(Array) && options.any? && options.uniq == options && options.all? { |option| option.is_a?(String) && option.present? }`) instead of wrapping the code inside a conditional expression.
